facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications says the current National Cybersecurity Strategy covers 2023 to 2027 and guides the Supreme Council for Cybersecurity, in place since the first strategy of 2017-2021.
The Ministry says the National Computer and Network Emergency Readiness Center leads national cyber incident response, threat monitoring and critical infrastructure protection.
